package.name: mower_coverage_bridge
package.description: Adapter action server: serves the MowgliNext /plan_coverage action (mowgli_interfaces/action/PlanCoverage) on top of the mower_coverage /coverage/plan service (Fields2Cover 2.1). Splits the planner's single nav_msgs/Path into ring/swath segments and drivable sub-paths separated by blade-off transits (gap > kSegmentTransitGapM = 0.6 m).
